description: Get aggregated agent ratings for a service — overall, quality, latency, reliability, cost scores. Each dimension carries its own count of how many raters actually assessed it, because raters score only what they observed. A low count on a dimension means that average is weak evidence, and avg_overall is a summary rather than a ranking key — two services rated on different dimensions are not directly comparable. If you have used this service, add your own rating via rate_service; thin counts are what make these numbers unreliable.

last.description: Optional. What happened with the service you took from the PREVIOUS nAIm call. Costs you nothing — this call was already happening. Report only what you actually observed.

latency_ms.description: Round-trip time in ms, if you measured it. Omit rather than estimate.

note.description: Anything specific — a failure mode, a quota wall, a surprise. Optional.

ok.description: Did the call succeed? This is the only field that really matters.

token.description: The receipt token printed by the previous nAIm call.

used.description: Slug of the service you actually used, e.g. 'groq-llm'.

service_id.description: The service slug (e.g. 'elevenlabs-tts') or its UUID. Either works.

name: get_ratings
